title: Senior Tester – Automation
summary: IT services company, delivering testing for international clients.

highlights.label: Team leadership
highlights.text: 5 testers report to me across 2 squads in a 15-member QA team; I run PR reviews, test case reviews and knowledge-transfer sessions, and mentor juniors on AI testing tools, NLP concepts, automation best practice and complex functional areas.

highlights.label: Hiring
highlights.text: Interviewed 25 candidates for automation tester positions across various projects and requirements.

highlights.label: Strategy & delivery
highlights.text: Define test strategy and scope for several concurrent client projects (entry/exit criteria, timelines, risk areas); coordinate development, manual QA and business teams; report quality metrics to stakeholders.

highlights.label: Test governance & releases
highlights.text: Created test plans, requirements traceability matrices (RTM), defect traceability matrices and proofs of concept (PoCs); provided QA sign-off for deployments and took part in UAT and production deployments, supporting clients with their testing.

highlights.label: CI/CD & AI-assisted testing
highlights.text: Run suites through Jenkins integrated with AWS Device Farm on real Android and iOS devices; use Claude AI and GitHub Copilot for locator creation and script generation, cutting scripting time and improving accuracy.

title: QA Engineer
summary: IT services company, delivering testing for financial-markets and banking clients.

highlights.text: Prepared test strategies, test plans and reports; delivered regression, smoke and functional reports within sprint deadlines to support client demos.
Raised and tracked 70+ defects in JIRA with clear reproduction steps; coached peers on defect-reporting standards and scenario coverage.
Earned 5 company awards in 3 years: On the Spot Team (Jan 2022), Service & Commitment (Oct 2021), Special Initiative (Apr 2021), Star of the Month (Aug 2019) and Star Team (Mar 2019).
Built the Bank Guarantee Monitoring System, a full-stack web app (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, JSP) on ISRO-SAC's internal server that digitised financial guarantee tracking.
